page.overview:
Who is Aviso?

Aviso was a male Human starship captain who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. In about 21 BBY, Aviso traveled to the planet Dorin to collect the XNA-580—a device developed by the Kel Dor Raahan Ma'ase that could manipulate the brainwaves of most species—on behalf of the Confederate leader Count Dooku.
